description: This line plot illustrates the comparison of Loss Ratio against TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and features discrete, visually uniformly spaced ticks with labels progressing in a non-linear sequence from 1e7 to 9e8 (specifically 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8). The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with numerical tick marks at regular intervals of 1. The Vanilla configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it maintains a constant value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis. The SepLLM (n=64) configuration is shown as a solid orange line with plus-sign markers, starting at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rising to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and ending at 100 at 9e8. The SepLLM (n=128) configuration is denoted by a solid dark blue line with 'x' markers, beginning at roughly 97.1 at 1e7, rapidly increasing to about 99.9 at 2e8, and remaining relatively steady to end at approximately 99.8 at 9e8. The SepLLM (n=64, H) configuration is depicted by a solid green line with diamond markers, starting at about 97.5 at 1e7, steadily climbing to a peak of approximately 100.2 at 6e8, and concluding at roughly 99.9 at 9e8. Lastly, the SepLLM (n=64, H/T) configuration is illustrated by a solid red line with circle markers, commencing at exactly 94.0 at 1e7, rising to about 99.1 at 4e8, experiencing a distinct dip to roughly 98.5 at 5e8, recovering to 99.0 at 6e8, and finishing at approximately 98.7 at 9e8.
